capabilities: insert a full table of contents into a note
create a table of contents for the next heading level
configure list style and header depth
extras: Suggests a CSS snippet for nested ordered-list numbering, which affects all ordered lists in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to generate a static table of contents as text inside a note.
summary: Plugin that inserts a Markdown table of contents for a note or for a heading's subheadings via commands.
